title: Nippy Twigs
html:
Nippy Twigs
Skill Type:  Self Buff
Trainer:  Mage
Number of Ranks:  1
Cost to Max:  121502
Chill Bill's attacks have increased damage, may reduce Attack Speed and Movment Speed and may Knockdown.

Activate this skill when Chill Bill is nearby to boost his feeble little twig hands with Ice Magic!
Every time he strikes an enemy his attacks will dish out ice damage that is roughly 350% more powerful than his normal attack damage for 60 seconds.
Each successful frigid hit slows the target's Movement and Attack Speed by 10% for 2 seconds and has a 33% chance to knock them down.


Skill Level: 1

Mana: 238

Duration: 60 Seconds

Cool Down: 30 seconds

Requires: Level 31

Upgrade Cost: 121502
